<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def orng(fr):
    px=[(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if fr.ascii.split('\n')[i][j]=='O']
    if not px: return None
    rs=[p[0] for p in px]; cs=[p[1] for p in px]
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
start=orng(current_frame)
print('start',start)
for mv in ['UP','DOWN','LEFT','RIGHT']:
    action([mv])
    pos=orng(current_frame)
    print(mv,'->',pos,'moved' if pos!=start else 'BLOCKED')
    # move back
    back={'UP':'DOWN','DOWN':'UP','LEFT':'RIGHT','RIGHT':'LEFT'}[mv]
    if pos!=start: action([back])
print('back to',orng(current_frame))
# Now inspect the black path rows/cols near the orange to understand geometry
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
# find black pixels in rows 30-38, cols 10-60
blk=[(i,j) for i in range(28,40) for j in range(10,62) if a[i][j]=='B']
rows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in blk)); cols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in blk))
print('black rows near orange',rows)
print('black cols near orange',cols)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
